title: Entity SKU enforces its tenant-scoped identity, invariant and lifecycle for consumers
risk: A consumer reads or writes SKU through a path that crosses the tenant boundary or ignores the invariant, so a wrong or foreign record becomes the basis of a customer-facing statement.
preconditions: Tenant T1 seeded in run-t1-unit-ent-sku with the fixture record for SKU identified by its business key
A tenant T2 record with an equivalent business key exists so cross-tenant reads can be attempted

inputs.invariant_under_test: quantity_available equals quantity_on_hand minus quantity_reserved and never goes below zero
inputs.refused_violation: SKU-ZERO with zero available cannot be carted or ordered
inputs.downstream_consumer_read: stock lookup returns quantity_available 0 with in_stock false and refuses the add

steps.action: Read and re-write the SKU record through the tenant-scoped repository/service using the fixture business key
steps.expected: the record round-trips with tenant_id T1, an immutable id and the business key intact

steps.action: Exercise the consumer path named for this entity
steps.expected: the consumer observes the invariant: quantity_available equals quantity_on_hand minus quantity_reserved and never goes below zero
the write is rejected with an explicit domain error and leaves no partial row, no orphan child and no side effect (SKU-ZERO with zero available cannot be carted or ordered)

steps.action: Repeat the read with the T2 tenant scope and with a caller lacking authority for this entity
steps.expected: T1 data is not returned, the T2 copy is unchanged and the denial is recorded rather than silently emptied

assertions: The persisted record carries tenant_id T1 and unique identity under (tenant_id, sku_code)
The consumer path reflects the invariant: quantity_available equals quantity_on_hand minus quantity_reserved and never goes below zero
The refused operation returns an explicit error naming the rule, and the prior state is byte-identical afterwards: SKU-ZERO with zero available cannot be carted or ordered
The T2 read returns no T1 row and the T1 read returns no T2 row
forbidden: Accepting the refused operation, or applying it partially before the error: SKU-ZERO with zero available cannot be carted or ordered
Returning, joining or counting another tenant's row on any consumer path of SKU
evidence: Repository read/write responses for both tenants including the business-key and tenant_id fields
Error code and message of the refused operation plus the unchanged row snapshot taken before and after
cleanup: Delete the run-scoped SKU rows and their child rows under run-t1-unit-ent-sku; keep the fixture and the denial audit entry
automation: Drive the repository/service API with the fixture payloads and assert on the returned projection, the error code of the violation and the cross-tenant read; the entity contract is enforced at the service boundary, so no DDL introspection is needed.
